pages.lesson:
LESSON: KUANDIKA 7.3.1 INSHA ZA KUBUNI MAELEZO

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.3: Kuandika 7.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Maelezo

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kuandika 7.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Maelezo. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kueleza maana ya insha ya maelezo
2. kutambua msamiati ufaao katika kutoa maelezo
3. kutambua umuhimu wa msamiati ufaao katika insha ya maelezo

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kueleza maana ya insha ya maelezo
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza maana ya insha ya maelezo. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kutambua msamiati ufaao katika kutoa maelezo
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua msamiati ufaao katika kutoa maelezo. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kutambua umuhimu wa msamiati ufaao katika insha ya maelezo
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua umuhimu wa msamiati ufaao katika insha ya maelezo. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kuandika 7.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Maelezo using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kuandika 7.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Maelezo in the examples.
2. Explain Kuandika 7.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Maelezo to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kuandika 7.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Maelezo.
4. Show that you can: kueleza maana ya insha ya maelezo

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kuandika 7.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Maelezo using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kuandika 7.3.1 Insha za Kubuni Maelezo important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kueleza maana ya insha ya maelezo
2. kutambua msamiati ufaao katika kutoa maelezo
3. kutambua umuhimu wa msamiati ufaao katika insha ya maelezo

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
